text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finished his very first Twinkle 
Series race, Biko Pegasus's chest burned 
with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, at the same time, Biko Pegasus's 
shortcomings are laid bare. In sprint 
races, her small stature and late-charging 
running style put her at a disadvantage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, it reaffirmed without a 
doubt that she was far better suited to 
turf than dirt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To steadily build up her strength, Biko 
Pegasus decided to enter races and hone 
her skills.
